args.title: Cold-Chain Logistics 2026 — Combined Summary (main + companion)
args.body:
- Temperature excursions fell 30% in 2026 where carriers shared live sensor data.
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilots cut claims by a quarter.

Sources: https://blog.corvid.example/2026/cold-chain and https://insights.corvid.example/cold-chain/companion
